newsitem.title: UK: NatWest downgrades Brit Biotech to "add".
newsitem.headline: NatWest downgrades Brit Biotech to "add".

text.p: NatWest Securities said on Tuesday it had downgraded its recommendation on British Biotech Plc shares to "add" from "buy", reflecting the slowdown in newsflow expected from the company over the next few months.

A NatWest spokesman told Reuters that with the group's most promising drug, cancer treatment Marimastat, now in lengthy late-stage trials, there would be little to stimulate the share price in the near term.
NatWest said the recent departure of British Biotech's research and development director had not greatly influenced its decision.
A "buy" recommendation implies an expectation that a stock will outperform the share market by around 20 percent, while "add" implies outperformance of around 10 percent, the spokesman said.
Shares in British Biotech were down seven pence at 248-1/2 by 1040 GMT.
